% generated by experiments/e2_dependence.py
Rejection rates under $H_0$ ($Q=P$: mix $\delta=0$ and block $b=20$, independent seeds) with Wilson 95\% intervals; $N$ = valid replications; independent windows.
$p$-values: permutation of the held-out evaluation labels with the network fixed (W-critic, LR-critic, C2ST; exact for independent windows), permutation (MMD, Sig-MMD), asymptotic (KS), Monte Carlo with 4000 null values ($n=500$), 1000 null values ($n=2000$) and randomised ties (LR oracle).
$^{\dagger}$ Every return of $Q$ has exactly the marginal law of $P$, so KS (pooled returns, marginal only) has no power by construction; the returns of one GARCH window share the conditional variance, so its nominal $p$-value is not valid either (rejection rate under $H_0$ at nominal 5\%: mix, $n=500$: 0.065 [0.038, 0.108]; mix, $n=2000$: 0.090 [0.058, 0.138]; block, $n=500$: 0.095 [0.062, 0.144]; block, $n=2000$: 0.075 [0.046, 0.120]). Its rejection rates are size distortions, not power.
